cost_boundaries.scope: Per method-seed sum over four budgets of recorded model training and job times; DCR includes its attributed shared prefix. Prefix attribution appears in both DCR methods; not physical total. Excludes pipeline downtime, recovery, data/preparation, test inference and transfer.

inference_limits: Separate four-method prospective amendment retains all six-method development outcomes; SupCon/NONL not confirmed.
Ratio and fullDCR use different selected ratio strengths, so their contrast is not a causal floor ablation.
DCR resets SGD after its shared one-epoch prefix; CE/Fisher continuous200epoch recipes differ.
Uniform-label supervised experiment, not an active-acquisition study.
No equivalence, annotation savings, robustness, causal mechanism or universal Fisher-method superiority claim.
Exact signflip inference is conditional on independent paired seed differences and sign exchangeability.
Same official test set across seeds; no third-party implementation replication.
